limitations: Only early exp and sigmoid cases, stopped at their first measurement-control failure; not a random sample of all 40 cases or five validation operators.
The 50 ms event total is a nominal interval calculation, not measured collector overhead or a guaranteed upper bound. Candidate events may be shorter or slower than the baseline pilot target.
Excludes model proposer/review, pilot, compilation, separate upfront full correctness, profiling, hardware queries and evidence replay.
Persistent verifier warm request cost, import share and actual five-operator completion time are unmeasured.
No thresholds, correctness checks or historical verdicts are changed.

calculation.clock: stage started_at/finished_at are recorded wall time; outer duration_seconds is the execution wrapper duration
calculation.component_seconds: adjacent differences of ordered_boundaries, without dropping failed-control cycles
calculation.native_envelope_limit: Includes process startup and receipt close/log finalization. No separate old native-process-exit timestamp exists.
calculation.oracle_envelope_limit: Whole Python CLI invocation including imports, math, input/output and process exit. Import cost is not measured separately.
calculation.other_limit: Residual categories are not a CPU attribution; CAS/output registration and identity work cannot be individually timed retrospectively.

source_binding_method: Reuse hashes already verified by the statistical audit and the campaign negative summary; no large-file hashing during the quiet window. Timestamp calculations freshly replayed from both complete raw files.
